protocol.meaning: Controlled counterfactual surfaces, not fitted AG materials. h_new(x,y)=height_scale*h_original(x/lateral_scale,y/lateral_scale). Array samples are unchanged; pitch, domain, nominal site spacing and Gaussian rounding all scale laterally together. This is not a strictly periodic 25um grating.
protocol.scope: Existing NumPy scalar-phase-screen function plus analytic single-hit facet Snell/Fresnel. No new native GPU backend runs or full 2D Maxwell validation.
